procedure: Copy the pack to a scratch root R, create an empty global vault V, then call add_lesson(config_path=R/'project.toml', repository_root=R, global_vault=V, request_path=R/'recording/proposal.json'). Compare the return value to expect.result. Then run run_compiler(mode='check') and compare to expect.recompile.
summary: The ONLY sanctioned machine recording path is akms_failure_memory.record.add_lesson (CLI: `failure-memory add --json`). It allocates the id under the project lock, validates the candidate registry before publishing it, writes atomically, recompiles, and rolls the registry back if the recompile fails. No consumer may open, append to and re-save lessons.json itself.
